entry.title: What Would Settle the Leakage Attribution in Magic-State Cultivation on Willow
entry.summary: A reading of the grafted-code memory gap on Willow. Leakage stays the likely main cause and is not ablated. The published v1 ratio is 6.6, inside 6.2 to 7.1. No 2 by 2 arm has been run. Cite concept DOI 10.5281/zenodo.23452622 for the always-latest PDF.

entry.title: willow-follow-up-note: leakage hybrid simulator and figure script
entry.summary: Distance-3 leakage hybrid simulator, Figure 1 script, and review files for the Willow note. The simulator is not a result of the note. The paper PDF is a separate Zenodo concept.

entry.title: patch-gap-hot-search: a synthetic HOT-searcher toy for the governance patch-gap
entry.summary: A stdlib Python toy that generates a discovery rate Rd on a Highly Optimized Tolerance rule graph. G and S are outputs of the toy, not measurements of any legal system. v0.2.0 adds Lean stock-algebra gates and frozen searcher arithmetic.

entry.title: The Governance Patch-Gap: Machine-Speed Exploit Discovery Against Human-Speed Legal Repair
entry.summary: AI lowers the cost of finding legal open texture while repair stays on a legislative clock. The paper defines the patch-gap G = Rd/Rp and stock S, and states three 2027 to 2028 predictions.

entry.title: Quantum-Safe Migration Playbook (Strategic & Operational Guide)
entry.summary: Type D knowledge base for operational post-quantum cryptography migration: 42 stable fact IDs, a federal M-26-15 filing layer, and a retrieval-eval suite. Cite concept DOI 10.5281/zenodo.19655681 for the always-latest edition.

entry.title: Golden Dome Latency Governance: Autonomous Operations Model Extended to Boost-Phase Intercept Timelines
entry.summary: Autonomous Operations Model extended to Golden Dome boost-phase and HGV intercept timelines: GEO delay and sparse downlink close HITL, so a 7-check edge gate and hub-tier model swap are specified. Architecture and detection outcome are unchanged in the October 2026 remint.

entry.title: The Computability Filter
entry.summary: The map from string-theory compactification data to thermalisation outcomes is argued to be independent of the working axioms, and uncomputable if the specification set is infinite. A separate conjecture treats the anthropic patch as a computability filter.

entry.title: aria-moebius: Lean formalization and class-bridge verifier
entry.summary: Lean 4 formalization and exhaustive GF(256) Python verifier for the invert-and-affine Mobius Bridge class identity. ARIA instantiates four members of that class. No ARIA attack complexities are claimed.

entry.title: fragile-proof-audit: gate-locked replay of published mathematical claims
entry.summary: Public campaign repository for Trust, but Replay: 32 locked gates (17 BREAK, 15 PASS), hash-pinned inputs, and a CI verdict lock matching paper v1.0.4. The paper PDF lives on a separate Zenodo concept.

entry.title: Trust, but Replay: Auditing Published Mathematical Claims
entry.summary: A six-day audit campaign that replays published mathematical claims under a hostile prior. The playbook is 32 locked gates, a five-disposition taxonomy, and a CI verdict lock that fails on drift.

entry.title: Fan-In Distributions in Human-Written vs AI-Generated Python Codebases: A Constructal Law Analysis
entry.summary: Import fan-in in mature Python OSS is mostly log-normal; AI-attributed repositories are flatter (agentic flattening). A small longitudinal pilot on mature repos does not show Gini decline after declared AI adoption.

entry.title: parabolic-fractal: code and data for "Fan-In Distributions in Human-Written vs AI-Generated Python Codebases: A Constructal Law Analysis"
entry.summary: Code, data, and figures for the fan-in Constructal Law paper. v1.1.0 accompanies paper v1.1; scripts/check_paper_claims.py recomputes every load-bearing number in the Version Note and Sections 5 to 7.7.

entry.title: A Numerical Test of the Quadratic Estimate in arXiv:2609.04176v1
entry.summary: A numerical check of Theorem 9.1 in Sun's Catalan-irrationality preprint. At B = 200 to 1200 the quadratic coefficient is the wrong sign, so that proof route cannot deliver the claimed bound.

entry.title: chokmah-me/catalan-sun-lean: v0.1.0: Thm 5.1 + Lemma 5.5 + Cor 5.2 Lean slice (Sun Catalan)
entry.summary: Lean 4 / Mathlib slice of structural lemmas from Sun's Catalan preprint, including Theorem 2.1, Theorem 5.1, Lemma 5.5, and related corollaries. Companion to the numerical test of Theorem 9.1.

entry.title: The Shibboleth Lattice: Recognition Channels and the Universality of In-Group Coordination
entry.summary: Coalition behavior across quantum, evolutionary, engineered, and language-model substrates is treated as one binding operator B with recognition-channel proxy kappa_H. The core prediction, blinded witness-set substitution, remains untested.

entry.title: Circular Leverage in Bank-NBFI Synthetic Risk Transfer Networks
entry.summary: When banks fund the NBFIs that buy their SRT protection, capital relief is partly self-funded. A network simulation shows a two-stage cascade transition in the self-funding fraction lambda, with a cliff near 0.95.

entry.title: lattice-GoldenDome-AOM: Golden Dome AOM falsification suite
entry.summary: Falsification suite for the Golden Dome AOM paper: executed A-E claim gates, the Scenario A payload-spoof cliff, and Monte Carlo coverage sweeps. This record is software only.

entry.title: Anduril LatticeOS: Autonomous Operations Model: Schema, Counter-Narrative, and Implementation
entry.summary: LatticeOS is mapped onto a four-layer Autonomous Operations Model. The governance gap is tenant observability, not the message bus. The primary failure mode is automation complacency (OWASP ASI09).

entry.title: Balance of Power 2026
entry.summary: Turn-based multipolar crisis simulation for international-relations research and war-studies teaching. Eight actors, thirteen domains, eight scenarios. Calibrated for face validity, not forecasting.

entry.title: Launcher Attrition Dominates Command Architecture: Agent-Based Analysis of IRGC Missile C2 Degradation, with Phase II Residual-Force C2 Observability Extension
entry.summary: Agent-based model, Phase II residual-force extension, and locked data tables for the launcher-attrition papers. Standard-library Python. Cite software concept DOI 10.5281/zenodo.19210120 for the always-latest zip.

entry.title: Below the Masking Threshold: Observable Command-and-Control Discrimination in a Residual IRGC Missile Force
entry.summary: Phase II preprint: in a residual IRGC missile force, an OSINT attribution-correlation proxy can discriminate active from pre-programmed C2 under sparse provocation. Dense provocation saturates that proxy.

entry.title: Mobius Bridges for the Invert-and-Affine S-box Class, with the Four ARIA Instantiations
entry.summary: The Nasr-Carlini Mobius Bridge holds for every invert-and-affine S-box; ARIA instantiates four members of that class. Lean spine plus exhaustive GF(256) checks. No ARIA attack complexities are claimed.

entry.title: chokmah-me/hashline: hashline 0.4.1
entry.summary: Line-range edits for LLM coding agents, with a content-hash tag on every read so patches against stale buffers are rejected. Works with Claude, Grok, DeepSeek, Gemini, Kimi, and any tool-using model.

entry.title: EML Expression Trees: Symbolic Regression, Basin Selection, and Hardware Realization on iCE40
entry.summary: Code, data, and notes for EML expression-tree research: snapping experiments, basin-selection warm starts, and iCE40 hardware realization of snapped exp and ln.

entry.title: Compressed by Discovery: Snapped Symbolic-Regression Primitives as Realizable, Verifiable Function Units on DSP-less FPGAs
entry.summary: On Lattice iCE40 fabric without DSP inference, argmax-snapped EML primitives for exp and ln are smaller and more accurate than quantized MLPs in a width/depth sweep, and bit-exact to a golden model.

entry.title: Valid and False Snapping in EML Expression Trees: The Basin Selection Problem
entry.summary: Snapping soft selectors in EML trees should recover exact symbolic forms. A symbolic-correctness criterion separates valid recovery from false snaps that look committed.

entry.title: Basin Selection in EML Expression Trees: Targeted Warm-Start and Top-Aligned Curriculum Achieve Full Valid Recovery for exp and ln, Including at Over-Representational Depth
entry.summary: Data and methods note: targeted warm-start and a top-aligned curriculum recover valid exp and ln at over-representational depth, where three-phase annealing alone does not.

entry.title: Claude Code Playbook v4.4.0
entry.summary: Token-efficient Claude Code workflows: agentic patterns, three-layer context control, path-scoped rules, Headroom compression, and supply-chain hardening.

entry.title: AttestationRegimeClassifier — Ghidra Plugin for ICS/Embedded Firmware Attestation Regime Classification
entry.summary: Ghidra plugin that classifies embedded firmware functions into three attestation regimes from the Computability Filter: formally provable, statistically testable, or adversarial-input exposure.

entry.title: On the Necessary Void at the Center of Autonomous Governance
entry.summary: When exception-decisions are delegated to autonomous systems whose latency bars real-time human ratification, the sovereign position is unoccupiable. The result is derived from three independent impossibility constraints.

entry.title: Three Regimes of Capability Attestation for Autonomous Agents
entry.summary: There is no single method to attest that an autonomous agent has a claimed capability. The right strategy depends on the agent's computational model and whether it may be adversarial.

entry.title: Recognition Channel Dynamics in the Shibboleth Lattice: A Simulation Study
entry.summary: Simulation companion to The Shibboleth Lattice. It exercises the binding operator B and recognition-channel proxy kappa_H under witness substitution and channel noise.

entry.title: fast16 as a Second-Order Subversion Attack
entry.summary: fast16.sys is classified as a second-order subversion: it reaches high-precision engineering codes through the OS filesystem stack, then the simulation tool above it. Defenses follow from the nth-order framework.

entry.title: Volt Typhoon as Operational Realization of the nth-Order Bleeding Thesis
entry.summary: Volt Typhoon is treated as an operational realization of the 2009 nth-order bleeding thesis: state adversaries hit mission-sustaining ancillary systems of advanced computerized infrastructure.

entry.title: Software simulation: Circular Leverage in Bank-NBFI Synthetic Risk Transfer Networks
entry.summary: Simulation code for circular leverage in bank-NBFI SRT networks: directed-graph contagion, lambda sweeps, and the two-stage cascade transition reported in the companion paper.

entry.title: How 'Stethoscopes' Unmasked Correlated Noise in Quantum Processors
entry.summary: Commentary on Google's OTOC experiments on a 65-qubit processor: correlated noise that independent-error benchmarks miss, and what correlator 'stethoscopes' change about device characterization.

entry.title: Quantum-Safe Migration Playbook (Strategic & Operational Guide)
entry.summary: Historical v1.2.0 of the Type D PQC migration knowledge base (superseded). Prefer concept DOI 10.5281/zenodo.19655681 for the always-latest edition; current version is 10.5281/zenodo.23347471.

entry.title: Launcher Attrition Dominates Command Architecture: Agent-Based Analysis of IRGC Missile C2 Degradation in the 2026 Iran War
entry.summary: Agent-based analysis of the 2026 Iran campaign's 92 percent drop in ballistic-missile launch rates. The decline is read as launcher attrition dominating command-architecture degradation.

entry.title: Dragon's Teeth: The PLA's UCAV Arsenal and Taiwan Invasion Strategy
entry.summary: Open-source assessment of PLA UCAV platforms and employment concepts for a Taiwan invasion, including saturation, decoy, and SEAD roles.

entry.title: Shahed-238 / Geran-3 UCAV Analysis: Companion Note to Dragon's Teeth (Second Edition, Revised March 2026)
entry.summary: Companion note on the Shahed-238 jet-powered one-way attack UAV and Russian Geran-3/4/5 variants, from the Shahed-136 lineage through early-2026 Ukraine use.

entry.title: Software and Data: Empirical Validation of Shadow-Price-Guided Inlining in MIR
entry.summary: Experimental infrastructure for shadow-price-guided inlining on the MIR JIT: synthetic profiling, the shadow-price mutation pass, and analysis scripts for the compiler-as-NUM paper.

entry.title: Empirical Validation of Shadow-Price-Guided Inlining in MIR
entry.summary: Three-phase validation of dual-decomposition inlining on MIR: synthetic frequencies, shadow-price mutation of MIR_CALL, and measured speedups against baselines.

entry.title: Empirical Validation of the Compiler-as-NUM Hypothesis: A Shadow-Price Experiment with MIR
entry.summary: A JIT doing profile-guided optimization is read as dual decomposition in Network Utility Maximization. A shadow-price experiment on MIR tests that mapping.

entry.title: The Compiler as a Decomposed Optimization System
entry.summary: Bilar (2007) on executable structure as engineered optimization is restated in the NUM framework: compiler architectures map onto distinct decomposition strategies.

entry.title: Modern Java 25 Thoughtbases (AI-native assets)
entry.summary: Structured Thoughtbase assets parsed from Van Dijk and Przybyl's Modern Java talks, for retrieval by AI coding agents rather than as a linear tutorial.
